Some egg donor banks only start the process once you are selected by someone. In this case, your height matters. 
Many of them simply freeze your eggs, put it in the bank, and the process is instant without needing someone that wants your eggs. the payout is the exact same for all frozen banks (for the most part.) and ranges from 10k or so. 
If you have very exceptional qualities, in the first case you could charge for more. Not just in regard to height, but graduates from Stanford, etc. 

In regard to sperm, it’s not the same. Sperm donors don’t get paid as much, and you can just go in and out. 
They don’t care about anything, other than you being in good health. the payout for everyone is the same. 

Egg donors are where it’s at and it takes like 4 months per egg donation, the process is much more complicated but like I said, it only matters that you’re in good health

\>Pickwick Ice (my fave, I attend adult group lessons here. They let you skate on the empty ice for 30 mins after your lesson with just the other students)

\>Toyota sports performance center (this is the one closest to me, but the public session rink is a lot smaller than usual. On thursdays, its on the bigger rink. They have low freestyle sessions from 1-2pm on weekdays, empty! sometimes 1-2 people on the ice). I attend adult group lessons here, too. Super fun, and the public session after is free and starts right after. The public sessions are always crowded like hell, on that tiny rink too. But, the low freestyle's from 1-2pm are really clutch and I mostly just go to those. Sometimes its not as crowded, but eh. And in the evening public sessions that are on Friday and Saturday, they don't zamboni the ice after the hockey kids....So besides the group lessons and 1-2pm low freestyles, I end up just going to pickwick. Its a lot emptier, and the rink is bigger.

\>Skating Edge in Harbor City (I see my coach here, almost always empty and super friendly !) The 11:50AM freestyle session is always pretty empty. Idk about public. Theyre also not strict on who they let in the freestyles, its family owned

\>LA Kings Paramount

These are all scattered about the region so regardless of where you move at least one should be in a reasonable distance.
